player impressions
Hoyos:  good distribution, good shot stopping.  having a good game
Báez - well enough.  trouble connecting passes.  handling the pressure on that side.
Mihaj - the controller along the back line.  Steady.
Gregersen - pushes higher than Mihaj.  Plays a bit riskier.   
Tomás - good both defensively and offensively.  Trying long balls and usually putting them in good spots
Muyumba - best game of the year so far
Fortune - he's finding his good form from last year.  Looks dangerous.  He'll probably tire before too long.
Sanchez - doing well when blocking the ball.  Stays on the left, being caught out based on his position a few times
Galarza - staying wide left.  players knows where he's at.  having a quiet game
Miranchuk - overlaps with Fortune and Tomás often.  Great work on the ball.  Looks dangerous
ELL - plays too deep, and his first touch is that of a player who hasn't played in 9 months
If ATLUTD were to make a sub - it should be for ELL
